description: The 'DUMMY' branch at app/cbl/COADM01C.cbl:138 and the statements it guards at 146-154. Line 138 reference-modifies the first five characters of CDEMO-ADMIN-OPT-PGMNAME(WS-OPTION); when they ARE 'DUMMY' the XCTL is skipped, and because an XCTL never returns those five statements are reachable on this path alone - line 147 blanks WS-MESSAGE, line 148 moves DFHGREEN over the mapset's COLOR=RED, lines 149-153 STRING 'This option ' and 'is coming soon ...' into it (the CDEMO-ADMIN-OPT-NAME operand between them is commented out in the source and stays out), and line 154 sends. Note that WS-ERR-FLG remains 'N' here: this is a successful path that happens not to transfer, not a rejection. app/cpy/COADM02Y.cpy names no DUMMY program, so the branch is unreachable from the copybook table and is driven through the option-table seam instead, with a single entry differing from the copybook's first entry in nothing but its program name - so the program name is the only variable under test. The branch is preserved and exercised rather than removed, because dead code is preserved, not cleaned up.
